units.source_text: 这样，我就站在为飞扬的尘土和丑陋的人群所包围的春天的金阁前。

en.t: In this way, I stood before the Golden Pavilion in spring, surrounded by flying dust and ugly crowds of people.

units.source_text: 在导游大声介绍的回响中，全阁总是佯装不知道似的，半隐藏着它的美，惟有在地面上的投影是汉明的，

en.t: Amid the echoes of the guide's loud explanations, the whole pavilion always seemed to feign ignorance, half concealing its beauty, while only its shadow on the ground was clear and bright,

units.source_text: 但乍看，恍如《众圣来迎图》上被众菩萨包围的来迎阿陀，

en.t: but at first glance, it looked like the welcoming Amida in a painting of the holy beings' descent, surrounded by many bodhisattvas,

units.source_text: 尘埃的云却活像环绕着众菩萨的金色的云，

en.t: and the clouds of dust looked exactly like golden clouds encircling those bodhisattvas,

units.source_text: 金阁在飞扬的尘土中呈现出朦胧的姿影，也恍如褪了色的旧颜料和磨破了的图案。

en.t: The Golden Pavilion showed a hazy silhouette in the flying dust, like faded old pigments and worn-out patterns.

units.source_text: 这种混杂和喧嚣，渗入仁立着的细长的柱子后面，

en.t: This mixture and clamor seeped in behind the slender columns standing upright,

units.source_text: 吸进了由小小的究竟须及其项上的凤凰渐渐变细耸立而连接着的发白的天空，

en.t: and was drawn up into the whitish sky joined to the small finial and the phoenix above it, rising and narrowing as it soared,

units.source_text: 建筑物只在这里存在，起着管制和限制内作用。

en.t: The building existed only here, performing an inner function of control and restraint.

units.source_text: 周围的躁动越来越厉害，西边面临漱清池，

en.t: As the agitation around it grew more intense, with the west side facing the Kyokochi Pond,

units.source_text: 头顶顶着二层上突然变小的究竟顶的金阁，

en.t: the Golden Pavilion bore above it the finial that suddenly grew smaller over the second story,

units.source_text: 这座不匀整的纤细的建筑物就越发起着不断地把浊水变为清水的过滤器似的作用。

en.t: and this uneven, delicate building increasingly acted like a filter that constantly turned muddy water into clear water.

units.source_text: 人们私语中的稽戏，也没有遭到金阁的拒绝，

en.t: Even the jokes and playfulness in people's whispers were not rejected by the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 它们却被吸进了立着的优美柱子之间，

en.t: but instead were drawn in between the graceful standing columns,

units.source_text: 不久就会被过德成一种寂静，一种澄明。

en.t: and before long they would be filtered into a kind of silence, a kind of clarity.

units.source_text: 于是，金阁不觉间也在地面上完成了如同毫不动摇的地面上的投影一样的东西。

en.t: Thus, without anyone noticing, the Golden Pavilion also completed upon the ground something like an utterly unmoving shadow cast on the earth.
